questions.text: A simple random walk on the integers starts at 0 and takes 441 steps of +1 or −1, each with probability ½. What is the expected highest position it reaches (0 if it never rises above the start)? (Settled by averaging 4,000 random walks.)
Two points are chosen independently and uniformly at random in a 1 × 8.9 rectangle. What is the expected distance between them? (Settled by averaging 400,000 random pairs.)
What is the average length of the longest increasing subsequence of a uniformly random permutation of 1,078 elements? (Settled by averaging 1,000 random permutations.)
In Python's Unicode database (Unicode 15.1.0), how many code points have the general category Nl (letter numbers)?
